name: pipeline-asymmetric-fees
description: Single LONG round trip with DIFFERENT per-side fee rates (buy 0.1% in base, sell 0.2% in quote), all-in buy@100, sell@110, half of 365.25d apart. Pins the per-side fee wiring: the runner/pipeline must route buyFeeRate to the buy fill (base) and sellFeeRate to the sell fill (quote), not a single shared rate. A symmetric-only implementation that applied one rate to both sides would produce output 1097.8011 (the pipeline-long-roundtrip-fees value) instead of 1096.7022. Note: metrics.cagrPercent is asserted by neither harness (single yield → first==last timestamp → CAGR=0 both engines); see metrics-cagr-multiyear.json for the CAGR contract.
